title: StageTip Extraction Protocol for Peptide Binding and Washing
author: Cristina CARDENAL PERALTA

steps.title: Adjust Sample pH
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample pH to approximately 2 by adding 10% TFA to a final concentration of 1% (typically around 20 µL), and verify with a pH strip.

steps.title: Prepare C18 Disks
steps.instruction: Use a homemade plunger to manually cut three Empore Disk C18 discs (each disk can harbor 10 ug of protein, totaling 30 ug).

steps.title: Assemble StageTips
steps.instruction: Insert the cut-out disks into a pipette tip and place the tip into a 1.5 mL tube with a hole in the top.

substeps.instruction: Pierce twice as many eppendorf tubes as samples needed
Set half of the tubes aside

steps.title: Condition StageTip with Methanol
steps.instruction: Pass 50 µL of methanol through the StageTip and centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 2 min.

steps.title: Equilibrate with ACN/TFA
steps.instruction: Pass 50 µL of 80% ACN/0.1% TFA through the StageTip and centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 3 min.

steps.title: Equilibrate with TFA
steps.instruction: Pass 70 µL of 0.1% TFA through the StageTip and centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 4 min.

substeps.instruction: Ensure all liquid has passed through the tip

steps.title: Bind Peptides
steps.instruction: Pass the sample through the StageTip to bind peptides and centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Process a maximum of 200 µL at a time

steps.title: Wash Bound Peptides
steps.instruction: Wash the StageTip with 70 µL of 0.1% TFA and centrifuge at 1200 rcf for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Ensure no liquid remains on top of the discs

steps.title: Store StageTips
steps.instruction: Place the tips in designated boxes and store at -20 °C.
